text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Suzuna has called {0} to meet up with her.
text_block_list.orig_text: スズナから呼び出された{0}──

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hey, whiz-boy! Whattup?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ヒデサイ！　
ちょす！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And look at the time! Right on the nose!
If you're ready, then let's mosey!
text_block_list.orig_text:
時間ぴったり。
さっすがヒデサイだね！
それじゃ、
いこっか。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You wanna know where?
Wait, did I forget to tell you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
どこに行くのかって……？
あれ？　
うち、
説明してなかったっけ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I wanna take you on a shopping spree.
See, I've got a fashion show coming up,
and I wanna bring my A-game!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きょうは買い物つきあってほしいんだよね。
今度、
ファッションショーあるから、
準備しておこうかなって。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I can definitely pick stuff out on my own and all, but like,
you gotta get other people's opinions and stuff, right? So I
was kinda hoping you'd gimme a couple of pointers.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うち一人で決めてもいいけど、
やっぱ人の意見って大事っしょ？
だからヒデサイにアドバイスもらいたいんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're like, super pliable and all!
Anyway, less talky, more shoppy! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイのこと、
頼りにしてるから！
ってことで、
お店にしゅっぱーつ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And we're here! This is like, my fav perfume place in the whole
WORLD.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とーちゃくっ！
ここ、
うちがよく来る香水屋さんなんだ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Huh? You wanna know why I'm getting perfume?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
なんで香水なのかって？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You thought I was just gonna be buying clothes or something?
Geez, you're like, painfully outta the loop sometimes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ファッションショーだから、
服買うと思ったの？
ヒデサイわかってないな～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Perfume gets people's attention, which means they'll be looking
at me and my clothes even more than before.
text_block_list.orig_text:
香水でテンション上げるから、
うちも、
うちが着てる服も
よく見えるようになるわけ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: So anyway, you get to be my sniffer dog today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とゆーわけで、
意見よろ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
What's up? You don't know anything about perfume?
Oh, you'll be fine! This is one of those things you just go
with your gut on, my guy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なに？　
香水に詳しくない……？
だいじょーぶ、
だいじょーぶ。
その辺はフィーリングっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
This shop lets you sample the perfume and stuff.
I'm gonna give myself a li'l spritz, so just tell me whatcha
think, 'kay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここの香水、
お試しできるんだよ。
うちがちょっと使ってみるから、
ヒデサイは、
感想だけ言ってくれればいいし。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, bee tee dubs, did you know some perfumes have like,
secondary effects to them?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
でも、
香水の匂いにも
色々と
効果があるんだよね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Like, uh... Lemme see... Aha! Here, check it out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えーっと、
たとえば……
……あった！　
これこれ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
This one's got like, uh... \"Notes of citrus that will make you
feel refreshed.\" Oh, and it's good for weight loss too!
How crazy is that?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ
シトラス系で
リフレッシュ効果があるんだよ～
それに！　
ダイエット効果もあるんだって！
ヤバぃよね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Whatcha think? Do I look any thinner?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう？
うち、
痩せたかな？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya mean it's not gonna kick in that fast? Ugh, lame.
Well, in that case, let's go for something else.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そんなにすぐに痩せるわけがない？
そっかぁ。
あ、
それじゃあ、
これは……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
How about this one?
This one's supposed to make you seem more sophisticated!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうどう？
この香水つけてると、
清楚な感じになるんだって！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: So? Am I looking more sophisticated yet?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ね！　
うち、
清楚になった！？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: You don't think so? Aww... Are you sure?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……清楚にはなっていない気がする？
う～
そっかなぁ～？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Just you wait! I'm pulling out the big guns now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
そだ！
それじゃあ、
とっておきのやつ、
付けるね！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: How's that? Notice anything different about me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どう？
うち、
なんか変わった感じしない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Wait, really? You don't think I look like, [i]any[/i] cuter?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
うちのこと、
魅力的に見えてこない？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Oh, c'mon! That is like, [i]such[/i] a cop-out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
適当に言ってるっしょ？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
What's going on here? They said this perfume was s'posed to
make men go nutso for you. You're not like, THAT oblivious, are
you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいなぁ？
男の人をメロメロにする香りって書いてあるんだけど？
ヒデサイ、
鈍感すぎぃ～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Man, I was really hoping you'd be all over me, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを付けたら、
ヒデサイ、
うちにメロメロになるかと思ったのに……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Oh well, I guess it doesn't matter. Let's just get our shop on!
I'm just gonna try a bunch on, so you just tell me which ones
you like best.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
香水の効果はいっか。
とりあえず、
色々試してみるから、
ヒデサイの好きな匂いがあったら教えて。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
We've tried out a whole bunch, but nothing's really like...
[i]popped[/i] or anything. Um, lessee... Maybe this guy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろんな香水使ったけど、
まだピンと来ないんだよね～
えっと、
次は……
これにしてみようかな？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hm?! This one... Whiz-boy, you gotta smell this one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん！？　
この香り……
ヒデサイ、
これどう思う？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Inorite?! It's like, it's my perfume! And they made it for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だよね！
なんか、
うちのイメージにピッタリって感じ！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, you too?! I'm like, totally in love with this one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイも！？
うちもこの香り、
おに好きかも～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You and I were totally thinking the same thing, huh?
It's like we're on the same brain-lengths or something!
text_block_list.orig_text:
同じこと思ったなんて、
うちらフィーリング合いまくりじゃね？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's no ifs, ands, or buts about it! This is the one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
きょう買う香水は、
これにけってー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Uh, hey. You're not looking too hot! You okay there?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
あれ！？
ヒデサイ、
顔色悪くない？
どーしたの？

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You're feeling sick?! Like, from the perfume?! Yeah, okay,
that's serious! We gotta get you outta here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
酔った！？　
香水の匂いに！？
おにヤバじゃん！
早く外いこー！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
You all right, whiz-boy? I guess perfume can make you pretty
sick if you're not used to it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒデサイ、
だいじょぶ？
香水の匂いって、
なれてないと気持ち悪くなるよね～

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
So hey, I think we should give up on the perfume for now and
go get you some tea. We'll hold off on the shopping 'til you're
feeling better.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とりま、
香水買うのはあきらめて、
その辺のカフェでお茶しよっか？
ヒデサイが治るまで休憩しようよ。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hm? You want me to just go on without you? Well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
気にしないで、
香水買ってきていい……？
そっか……

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm good. You're not good with perfume, so like,
I think I'm gonna pass on it, tbh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
やっぱりいいよ。
ヒデサイが香水になれてないなら、
使わなくてもいいかな～って。

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
And you know what? I think I'm gonna go
without it at my show too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度のファッションショーも、
香水なしで出ることにしたから！

text_block_list.name: Suzuna
text_block_list.text:
So without further adieu, let's get you to a cafe!
We've got plenty of time to hang, so let's make the most of it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってわけで、
カフェいこっか！
残りの時間は、
いっぱい遊んじゃお～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
After this meeting with {0}, Suzuna decided 
that she would no longer wear perfume anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}と会う時は、
香水を使わなくなったスズナであった。
